name: Erchitu
body:
Erchitu (Human Form)
CR 3

This horrific beast resembles a great white minotaur with pitch black eyes and iron-coated horns. Its bellow is like an announcement of doom.

XP 800
Human afflicted erchitu brawler 3
NE Medium humanoid (human, shapechanger)
Init +1; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+4 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 27 (3d10+6)
Fort +5, Ref +4, Will +2; +4 on Fort vs. nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments, and suffocation damage (Endurance)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk handaxe +6 (1d6+2/x3) or unarmed strike +5 (1d6+2) or unarmed strike brawler’s flurry +3/+3 (1d6+2)
Special Attacks brawler’s flurry (Two-Weapon Fighting), martial flexilbility 4/day, maneuver training (bull rush +1)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +3; CMB +5 (+8 with bull rush); CMD 16 (19 vs. bull rush)
Feats Crushing Impact, Endurance, Improved Unarmed StrikeB, Improved Bull RushB, Power Attack
Skills Intimidate +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7
Languages Common
SQ brawler’s cunning, change shape (human, hybrid, and auroch; polymorph), martial training

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary
Treasure NPC gear (chain shirt, mwk handaxe, other gear)

Erchitu (Hybrid Form)
CR 3

XP 800
Human afflicted erchitu brawler 3
NE Large humanoid (human, shapechanger)
Init +1; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)
hp 30 (3d10+9)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +2; +4 on Fort vs. nonlethal damage from hot or cold environments, and suffocation damage (Endurance)
DR 5/silver

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk handaxe +6 (1d8+3/x3) or unarmed strike +5 (1d8+3), gore +5 (1d8+3), or unarmed strike brawler’s flurry +3/+3 (1d8+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks brawler’s flurry (Two-Weapon Fighting), death bellow, iron horns, martial flexilbility 4/day, maneuver training (bull rush +1), stampede, trample (2d6+4, DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 13, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +3; CMB +7 (+10 with bull rush); CMD 18 (21 vs. bull rush)
Feats Crushing Impact, Endurance, Improved Unarmed StrikeB, Improved Bull RushB, Power Attack
Skills Intimidate +6, Knowledge (local) +6, Perception +7, Sense Motive +7
Languages Common
SQ brawler’s cunning, change shape (human, hybrid, and auroch; polymorph), lycanthropic empathy (wild and domesticated bovines), martial training

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Brawler’s Cunning (Ex)

As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, its Intelligence counts as 13 for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of combat feats.

Brawler’s Flurry (Ex)

As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, it can make a brawler’s flurry as a full-attack action. When doing so, it has the Two-Weapon Fighting feat when attacking with any combination of unarmed strikes, weapons from the close fighter weapon group, or weapons with the “monk” special feature. It does not need to use two different weapons to use this ability. The erchitu applies its full Strength modifier to its damage rolls for all attacks made with brawler’s flurry, whether the attacks are made with an off-hand weapon or a weapon wielded in both hands.

It can substitute disarm, sunder, and trip combat maneuvers for unarmed attacks as part of brawler’s flurry. The erchitu can’t use its natural weapons as part of brawler’s flurry, nor can it make natural weapon attacks in addition to its brawler’s flurry attacks.

Death Bellow (Su)

Once per night as a full-round action, an erchitu can release a powerful bellow that means terror and death for those who hear it. Creatures within 40 feet that fail a DC 14 Will save become paralyzed with fear for 1 round, then frightened for 1d2 rounds, and then shaken for 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect.

Iron Horns (Ex)

The erchitu’s gore attacks are treated as adamantine for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.

Lycanthropic Empathy (Ex)

An erchitu can communicate and empathize with animals related to its animal form only when in its animal or hybrid form. It can use Diplomacy to alter such an animal’s attitude, and when so doing gains a +4 racial bonus on the check.

Maneuver Training (Ex)

As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, it gains a +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks when performing one chosen combat maneuver and a +1 bonus to its CMD when defending against that maneuver.

Martial Flexibility (Ex)

As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, it can take a move action to gain the benefit of a combat feat it doesn’t possess. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The erchitu must meet all the feat’s prerequisites. It may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + ½ its brawler level (at 3rd level, that’s 4 times per day). The erchitu can use this ability again before the duration expires in order to replace the previous combat feat with another choice. If a combat feat has a daily use limitation (such as Stunning Fist), any uses of that combat feat while using this ability count toward that feat’s daily limit.

Martial Training (Ex)

As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, it counts its total brawler levels as both fighter levels and monk levels for the purpose of qualifying for feats. It also counts as both a fighter and a monk for feats and magic items that have different effects based on whether the character has levels in those classes (such as Stunning Fist and a monk’s robe). This ability does not automatically grant feats normally granted to fighters and monks based on class level, namely Stunning Fist.

Stampede (Ex)

A stampede occurs if three or more creatures with stampede make a trample attack while remaining adjacent to each other. While stampeding, the creatures can trample foes of their size or smaller, and the trample’s save DC increases by +2.

Unarmed Strike

As the sample erchitu is a 3rd-level brawler, it gains Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. A brawler may attack with fists, elbows, knees, and feet. This means that the erchitu may make unarmed strikes with its hands full. The erchitu applies its full Strength modifier (not half) on damage rolls for all its unarmed strikes. Usually, a brawler’s unarmed strikes deal lethal damage, but the erchitu can choose to deal nonlethal damage instead with no penalty on its attack roll. It has the same choice to deal lethal or nonlethal damage while grappling. The erchitu’s unarmed strike is treated as both a manufactured weapon and a natural weapon for the purpose of spells and effects that modify either manufactured weapons or natural weapons. The erchitu also deals 1d6 points of damage with its unarmed strikes (1d8 when in its hybrid form).

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary or herd (one erchitu plus 1d6 oxen)
Treasure NPC gear (chain shirt, mwk handaxe, other gear)

According to legends, a human being who is guilty of a grave crime, but for whatever reason has not been convicted for it and so failed to expiate, can be cursed to transform into a boe erchitu on the nights of full moon. It can only assume its hybrid or animal form at night. To become human again at dawn, the erchitu must then perform some ritual action, like rolling in the dust of a consecrated ground.

It is said that the erchitu roams the countryside at night, accompanied by similar beasts it called to itself and, sometimes, by horned fiends. If it stops before a house and bellows three times, then the house’s owner is destined to die within one year. The erchitu never delivers more than one such death omen in the same night.

This giant humanoid is covered in shaggy, white hair, with an ox-like head crowned by gleaming, metal horns. A massive yoke of black iron is fastened about its burly neck.

An erchitu is formed from a humanoid that has committed heinous crimes in their lifetime. Fearful of the punishments that await them, they bargain with hellish powers, seeking to stave off their final judgement. Hell grants a reprieve, sending the humanoid back as a monstrous agent to wreak more havoc in the mortal world, knowing its soul will eventually make its way back to the hells in time.

The erchitu’s new form is a massive ox wearing an iron yoke, symbolic of its hellish bargain. The horns of an erchitu are gleaming steel. An erchitu is free to go about the world sowing misery as it sees fit, but whatever lord of Hell forged the bargain will want to direct the erchitu to specific acts of evil when it chooses. Often when an erchitu is encountered, it is in the company of one or more lesser devils, sent to deliver orders to the erchitu and see that they are carried out, occasionally assisting in the task if necessary.

On rare occasions, an erchitu is a soul that genuinely seeks redemption, but was too late. The humanoid takes the deal to become an erchitu as a last attempt at salvation. Such an erchitu will go to outrageous lengths, trying any ritual or taking any quest in order to find a way to cast off its hellish yoke and become its n o r m a l self again. Such repentant erchitu nearly always have devils nearby, attempting to sabotage its attempts at salvation and goad it into doing the bidding of its diabolical master.
